name: Michigan Boat Launch Product V4
purpose: Measure whether one map-first statewide finder lets a boater discover, search, compare and act on real Michigan public launches without redundant inputs or source shortcuts.
fatalFailures: Known false launch displayed as real.
Great-Lakes-only source gate excludes inland public launches.
More than one user-facing text search box for launch discovery.
Map does not contain the full filtered statewide source-backed inventory.
Map and result details do not share one normalized source record and coordinate.
Destination ranking uses straight-line order when drive routing is available.
Weather is presented as a boating-safety determination.
Source failure falls back to guessed or legacy launch pins.
releaseRule: Do not merge unless score is at least 95/100, zero fatal failures, the statewide live inventory is runtime-verified, inland and Great Lakes acceptance destinations work, and preview deployment is Ready.
